Sleep screenshot OCR — locally hosted browser dependencies

Tesseract.js 7.0.0 and tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 (Apache-2.0)
https://registry.npmjs.org/tesseract.js/7.0.0
https://registry.npmjs.org/tesseract.js-core/7.0.0
Official package archive SHA-512 integrity was verified before extraction.
Only browser distributions and embedded-WASM LSTM variants are included.
Tesseract / Leptonica upstream notices are included alongside wrapper licenses.

English and Japanese models: tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast, main, retrieved 2026-10-25.
https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast
Original eng.traineddata and jpn.traineddata compressed with gzip (mtime=0).
Apache-2.0 license retained. Model hashes are pinned in ocr-assets.json.

Bundled worker notices: buffer 6.0.3 (MIT), ieee754 1.2.1 (BSD-3-Clause),
zlibjs 0.3.1 (MIT), regenerator-runtime 0.13.11 (MIT).
Exact package LICENSE files retained. Distribution license comments retained.

Images are decoded and recognized on the user's device. No image upload.
The app fetches these assets from its own origin only, on first use.
Do not publish screenshots, test fixtures or user research data in this directory.
